newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady to weaker, good supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady to weaker, good supply.

text.p: NWE jet premiums were steady to a touch weaker on Monday in a slow market suffering from good supplies of product.
A barge traded on Monday at March IPE gas oil +$23 fob ARA, about $1 off Friday's level. Cargo premiums were steady around March IPE gas oil +$25 cif NWE.
Premiums in the Med were down to $10 above the screen and some material has been taken into the North.
"The problem is demand in the North is not very strong and the market could get quickly flooded," said one trader.
Easing barge premiums could see barge material being used to make up cargoes, dealers said.
